name: Document engineering measured acceptance contract

rules.measurement: Actual Chromium and office PDF page counts equal requested pages
DOCX and PDF preserve ordered source glyphs and every semantic table cell
Document run font sizes, including default body settings, at least approved minimum (11pt for this résumé)
Office application and Chromium PDF agree on page count and reading order; report geometry deltas
Compare actual page geometry with viable unconstrained/compact layouts, not universal utilization cutoff
Actual page line positions: heading and its first content block on same page, and bullets kept together when feasible
Heading, employer/date, first substantive accomplishment and related bullets form cohesive group when capacity allows
Table headers repeated appropriately; no stranded row/numbered clause label or signature heading
Independent page image inspection by qualified reviewer, assessing balance, hierarchy, hierarchy scale, whitespace reasons, margins, consistent rhythm
No assertion 'professionally passed' for technical-only delivery; stricter requested professional-quality contract blocks bad deliverables
Qualification uses deterministic local reviewer and browser/LibreOffice only

release_policy: Never declare Phase 2 or 3 qualified while any mandatory requirement is pending or failing.
